heading: Our suite of UI/UX design tools
text2: KeyDevs Technologies has a team of designers who work with the leading design, prototyping and collaboration tools.

items.title: Figma Design
items.text: Figma is where we design, prototype and build design systems collaboratively, so you can review work in real time and developers can inspect specs directly.

items.title: Sketch Design
items.text: Sketch remains a favourite for interface design and symbol-based design systems, particularly for teams already working in the Apple ecosystem.

items.title: InVision Prototyping
items.text: InVision turns static designs into clickable prototypes that you can share, test and comment on with your team and users.

items.title: Justinmind Prototyping
items.text: Justinmind lets us create detailed, data-driven interactive prototypes for complex web and mobile products.

items.title: Adobe Photoshop & Illustrator
items.text: Photoshop and Illustrator power our branding, iconography and illustration work for polished, distinctive interfaces.

items.title: Adobe After Effects
items.text: After Effects helps us design motion and micro-interactions that make products feel alive and guide users naturally.
